purpose: Corresponding source for GPL/LGPL components redistributed in Constellarr runtime artifacts (Alpine 3.24 packages and Python packages from PyPI).
selection_rule: Alpine package origins whose declared license expression contains GPL or LGPL terms, plus the Python GPL package auditok. Origins whose expression offers a non-GPL/LGPL alternative are marked "elective_alternative": true and are not collected by default.
checksums: sha512/sha256 values copied from the shipped Alpine APKBUILDs (sha512sums/sha256sums) and from PyPI release metadata.
notes: Alpine recipes (APKBUILD) are bundled in-repo under third_party/licenses/alpine/.
par2cmdline corresponding source is additionally bundled in-repo under third_party/licenses/par2cmdline/.
Source files are downloaded to an external output directory; they are not stored in git.
